item.title: A Court Has Ruled That Google Is Liable for False Statements Generated by AI Overviews
item.description: The ruling holds that a company that designs, trains, operates, and manages an AI system must assume legal liability for any damages caused by the responses it generates.

item.title: Anthropic Says It’s Taking Claude Fable 5 Offline to Comply With US Government Order
item.description: “The government believes it has become aware of a method of bypassing, or ‘jailbreaking’ Fable 5,” the company said in a blog post.

item.title: Meta Employees Absolutely Hate Mark Zuckerberg’s Plan for a Companywide AI Hackathon
item.description: “I’m not sure that this company supports a hackathon culture anymore,” one employee posted in a forum open to the entire staff.

item.title: ‘Tell Him He’s a Piece of Shit’: Meta’s New AI Unit Is a Total Mess
item.description: Executives and employees alike are struggling with Meta’s chaotic AI strategy, according to sources and internal discussions reviewed by WIRED.

item.title: China Didn’t Make Americans Hate Data Centers
item.description: GOP lawmakers, tech investors, and even OpenAI have tied the anti-data-center movement in the US to Chinese interference. Experts say it’s much more complicated than that.

item.title: You Probably Won’t Get Rich Off the SpaceX IPO
item.description: The company has set aside an unusually high number of shares for retail investors. Still, experts say, you’re just getting the crumbs.

item.title: Apple’s Camera Chief Thinks AI Can Give You Superpowers
item.description: The generative features in iOS 27’s new Photos app will add fake pixels to some of your shots, but Apple’s Jon McCormack says the company isn’t using AI “for the sake of AI.”

item.title: Why You Might Already Own SpaceX Shares, Siri’s AI Makeover, and Knicks Owner’s Surveillance Machine
item.description: Today on Uncanny Valley, we take an early look at the SpaceX IPO and why you might find yourself among the investors without even realizing it.

item.title: Meet the OpenAI Engineer Leading ChatGPT’s Biggest Transformation Yet
item.description: Thibault Sottiaux helped make AI coding one of OpenAI’s fastest-growing businesses. Now he’s overseeing a sweeping overhaul of ChatGPT.

item.title: Grok Is Still Hosting Sexualized Deepfakes of Famous Women
item.description: A WIRED investigation found dozens of “nudified” deepfake images and videos on Grok's website, including nonconsensual depictions of celebrities and at least one prominent US politician.
